intro: Browse the raw content of the BACKUP/ folder on each external drive — backups and migration snapshots from every machine present on this drive, not just this server.
selectFilePrompt: Select a file to see its detail.
restoreHint: Use Restore > USB to restore a backup from this server; migration snapshots (manifest.json) open directly from here.
actionsHint: Download and delete are available from BACKUP/<machine>/<category>/<item> downward; the levels above can only be browsed.
encryptedHint: Encrypted file (.enc): decrypt it with your private key (see Help, "Opening a .tar.gz.enc archive outside the application").

deleteConfirm.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteConfirm.descriptionFile: This backup file will be permanently deleted from the USB drive. If it is the only copy, it will be lost.
deleteConfirm.descriptionFolder: This folder and everything in it will be permanently deleted from the USB drive. If these are the only copies, they will be lost.
deleteConfirm.descriptionMigration: This complete migration snapshot (images, volumes, databases, configuration) will be permanently deleted from the USB drive.

errors.permission_denied: Not enough permissions to delete this item on the drive.
errors.path_not_allowed: This level cannot be downloaded or deleted.
